title: Relation of Biology with Other Sciences
topicTitle: Relation of biology with other sciences
notes: The exploration of life science involves knowledge of other basic sciences like Physics and Chemistry.
The combination of these disciplines contributes to a comprehensive perspective.
Relation with Chemistry The physiological processes of plants and animals are intricately linked with chemical reactions.
Biochemistry, situated at the intersection of Biology and Chemistry, is the discipline that addresses this intersection.
Living organisms contain both organic and inorganic compounds, which play a crucial role in shaping various life processes.
Energy is transferred within the body through organic chemicals like glucose.
Chemical changes are integral to metabolic pathways, including photosynthesis, respiration, and metabolism.
